landing.title: Welcome to Retro Desktop.exe
landing.headline:
Your own little universe,
on a retro desktop.
landing.description: Drag windows, add images and links, and create a digital card, an OC showcase, or a portfolio in minutes. No coding required, and it works on phones too.

choose.title: Choose an address and theme
choose.description: Pick your personal address and a retro color scheme.

add.title: Add windows
add.description: Add documents, galleries, links, and a profile card, then drag them into place.

publish.title: Publish and share
publish.description: Preview desktop and mobile layouts, publish, and share your address.

card.name: Digital card — Mochi
card.description: Profile fields, a bio, social links, and a banner.

ig.name: Retro IG — pixel 日記
ig.description: Follower counts, a bio, and a post grid with a 2000s feel.

oc.name: OC showcase — 月面圖書館
oc.description: Character profiles, reference galleries, and worldbuilding documents.

portfolio.name: Portfolio — Ren
portfolio.description: An introduction, an artwork grid, and contact details.
